title: Jester and Button Fairy
description: A surreal scene featuring a black and white jester figure with a horned crown floating above a large mound of colorful buttons, facing a vibrant fairy with yellow butterfly wings made of green foliage, berries, and flowers who offers him a small bouquet.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene with a black and white jester wearing an ornate horned crown and ruffled collar floating in the upper left, reaching toward a beautiful fairy in the lower right. The fairy has large translucent yellow butterfly wings, her body and dress composed of green leaves, red berries, and white flowers. She holds up a small bouquet of flowers to the jester. They are positioned on and around a massive overflowing mound of colorful vintage buttons in red, blue, purple, and white that fills the bottom of the image. Dark smoky background with floating button symbols and a faint dark silhouette of a castle or figure behind them, in a detailed illustrative painting style with high contrast between the monochrome jester and the vibrant colorful fairy and buttons.
